subject: Discovery fails for 3 servers in rack B
body: Our nightly discovery job finished, but 3 servers in rack B show as unreachable with error DSC-101. They were fine last week. We moved them to a new switch on Friday.

subject: Discovery broken after password rotation
body: Security made us rotate the out-of-band management passwords on all rack C servers yesterday. Since then every discovery run on that rack fails with DSC-102. Do I have to update the credentials somewhere in the fleet manager as well?

subject: Job stuck on Running for 2 days, everything else queued
body: This is the second time this month. The 'Weekly full scan' discovery job has said Running since Sunday morning. Our firmware and inventory jobs are all sitting in Queued behind it, and when I hit Cancel I just get JOB-201. I need this cleared today.

subject: Discovery only found 12 of 30 servers
body: Ran discovery against 192.0.2.0/24 and expected 30 servers. Only 12 came back. The job says Completed and shows no errors.

subject: Can't save discovery job
body: New discovery job won't save. It just says Invalid field and doesn't tell me which one. Tried in two different browsers, same thing.

subject: API calls start returning 401 after about an hour
body: My inventory script logs in once and then polls the API every 5 minutes. It works fine for roughly an hour, then every call fails like this: 2026-11-05T14:12:09Z GET /api/v1/devices -> 401 Unauthorized. Restarting the script fixes it until the next hour.

subject: Devices API returns only 50 servers
body: GET /api/v1/devices only gives me 50 servers but we have 212. The response also has no memory size for any of them. Is there a parameter I'm missing?

subject: URGENT: srv-a-007 critical after fan failure
body: srv-a-007 went critical about 10 minutes ago right after a fan failure alert. This box runs our payroll database and payroll closes tonight. What do I do right now??

subject: Firmware update failed on 2 of 20 servers
body: Pushed the firmware update to all 20 servers in rack D last night. 18 finished fine, but srv-d-003 and srv-d-011 failed with FW-301. Should I retry them or roll them back?

subject: No alerts since Tuesday
body: We haven't received a single alert since Tuesday. We normally get 20 to 30 a day, so this can't be right. Nothing changed on our side that I know of.
